You are working on GitHub issue #87: "[P2][task] Add missing T0/T1 journey timing in inbound message paths"

## Issue Details
BaseChannelPlugin defines journey timing checkpoints (T0-T11) for end-to-end latency measurement, but T0 and T1 are inconsistently captured:

| Checkpoint | Method | WhatsApp | Discord | Slack | Telegram | A2A |
|------------|--------|----------|---------|-------|----------|-----|
| T0 | captureT0() | YES | YES | YES | NO | NO |
| T1 | captureInboundTimings() | YES | YES | YES | NO | NO |
| T2 | captureT2() | YES | YES | YES | YES | YES |

### Impact
Inbound latency (platform → SDK → event bus) is invisible for Telegram and A2A. Can measure outbound (T10→T11) but not inbound (T0→T2) for those channels.

### Fix
In each channels inbound message handler, call captureT0(platformTimestamp) and captureInboundTimings().

### Acceptance Criteria
- All channels capture T0 from platform timestamps (Telegram and A2A need adding)
- All channels call captureInboundTimings() in message handlers
- Inbound latency (T0→T2) visible in event metadata
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
